title: The primary ext4 superblock is relative to the filesystem start
summary: The primary superblock is 1,024 bytes from the start of the filesystem. In a partitioned image, add the starting byte offset of the partition.
applies: ext4 filesystem images and the Linux kernel format documentation
detail: The magic number field is located inside the superblock at offset 0x38, and the integer 0xef53 is stored in little-endian byte 53 ef.
boundary: Backup superblocks follow a separate layout. An arbitrary two-byte match is insufficient evidence of a valid filesystem.
relevance: Explains why the header is visible at a fixed offset in a partition image but absent at that same offset in the full disk image.
